easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Raucous Audience by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Raucous Audience.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Raucous Audience.
Repeat.
